note: Spec 23 Food Compass live lens, P0-P6. Rebuilds Scott Black's One Good Choice capability on this codebase's rule that the model never computes numbers: 9,273 published Food Compass 2.0 scores extracted from Table S5 plus 6,150 joined FNDDS 2017-18 nutrient panels, a deterministic TypeScript scoring engine, a live camera loop, the score on /food and in the meal log, and a standalone shareable /compass preview with a realtime voice tool that looks scores up rather than recalling them. The three discrepancy-ledger items were resolved empirically before any engine code was written, against a clean subset of 110 foods whose D4/D5 contributions are provably zero: dairy half-weight is halve-then-plain-average (dairy r 0.919 vs 0.847), D7 top-3 is a weighted mean (bcMAE 2.70 vs 3.35), and the nitrite 25-vs-50% question is not discriminable with the available data and is recorded as such rather than guessed. Also fixes three defects found on the way: the storage guard would have silently dropped every pre-spec-23 meal-log entry, the live loop could enter an unbounded request loop against a paid endpoint, and 'partially hydrogenated soybean oil' counted as two binary additives instead of one. Ships the 12 previously undeployed spec 22 ladder-trust commits alongside; production was last at 4555c09 (2026-08-05).
